task: ae.qos: packet schedulers (FIFO, strict priority, DRR, SCFQ-WFQ), per-flow token-bucket shaper, link simulator and invariant checker with oracles and a 39-mutant pass
reasoning_summary: Designed schedulers behind a small Scheduler interface and a discrete-time link simulator, wrote hand-derived literal traces plus oracle-based property tests (offline DRR rounds, naive SCFQ recompute, tick-by-tick token bucket, fairness bounds) before the implementation. All 44 tests passed on the first run; a 39-mutant pass found two test gaps which were closed, the remaining survivors are justified as equivalent.
